images.caption:
This is Mt. Madjaas - known to be the highest peak in the Panay Island. What I like about the hike is that almost 3/4 of the trail is covered with trees. This mountain is also well-known for its bonsai forest where we can find the bonsai trees exhibiting a crown-shyness phenomenon.
Very Magical. It also has a great campsite just by the cool Bantang River.
